title: Limits on the atomic description of four-wave mixing
summary: The limits of the well-established single-atom model for describing photon-pair generation via four-wave mixing in a diamond configuration in atomic ensembles are experimentally tested. Using a cold-atom source, biphotons are generated and detected through polarization analyzers that resolve the emitted light into horizontal and vertical components in the laboratory frame. The pump lasers driving the first and second excitation transitions are horizontally and vertically polarized, respectively.
